workflow.title: Phase I Environmental Site Assessment
workflow.description: Primary regulatory, records, database, mapping, and technical resources commonly used to support environmental due diligence in Connecticut.

relationships.workflow_note: Open as the federal All Appropriate Inquiries framework relevant to environmental due diligence and associated landowner-liability considerations.
Open the authoritative ASTM product page for the professional practice standard commonly used for Phase I Environmental Site Assessments.
Use during records review to identify known or potentially contaminated properties associated with or near the subject property.
Search identified properties for release, assessment, cleanup-status, and available remediation information.
Search historical DEEP records and supporting documents, including material submitted before the transition to REACT.
Review current and historical registered commercial UST facility and tank records associated with the subject property and surrounding properties.
Review documented releases from federally regulated UST systems associated with identified facilities.
Use for spatial screening of mapped environmental cleanup properties and releases near the subject property.
Screen for known brownfield properties and documented state or federal brownfield-program involvement.
